row1.text: 1 · First launch: see it, then learn by playing

row1note.text:
Numfall in 5 lines

1. Sudoku rule: each number once per row, column and box.
2. You don't tap cells. Pick a number, tap a COLUMN, and it falls to the lowest gap.
3. So the ORDER matters: fill the lower gaps first.
4. WIN: fill the grid before the countdown hits 0s.
5. LOSE: time's up, or 3 wrong drops (each one cracks and costs a heart).

Three boards, all open from the start: Quick 4×4 (30 levels), Classic 6×6 (100) and Master 9×9 (100).

First run: Welcome, then "Who's playing?" (name only, kept on the device and in the player's own iCloud), then the tutorial.

Press Play on screens 3, 4 and 7. They really work.

row2.text: 2 · The core loop: play, win or lose, go again

row2note.text:
The winning "hit"

• Every correct drop: a weighty landing plus a haptic tick.
• Finish a row, column or box: flash, chime, +1 Spark (once each, so undo can't farm).
• One drop finishing 2 or 3 at once: DOUBLE (+3) / TRIPLE (+8).
• Countdown turns amber at 30s and red with ticks at 10s. At 0s: "Time's up!" and the level starts again.
• Level end: stars fill one by one, seconds left turn into Sparks.

row3note.text:
v1 economy: no ads, no purchases

Every Spark is earned by playing: level 10 · no mistakes +10 · 1 per 5s left (max 20) · lines +1, combos +3/+8 · Daily Drop +25 · milestone chest 150 (every 10 levels on each board). A perfect level is about 50.

Spend: hint 40 · extra undo 15 · +1 heart 60 (once per attempt) · SKIP LEVEL 400 (after 2 failed tries).

The timer is the challenge: no way to buy extra time. Time's up = start the level again.

Purchases and ads may come in a later version.

row4.text: 4 · iPad: same game, layouts made for the big screen

row4note.text:
iPad

• Landscape: board on the left (96pt tiles), timer, hearts, Sparks and a big 3×2 number tray on the right.
• Portrait: two-column home with the whole chapter visible.
• Narrow Split View windows fall back to the iPhone layout.

Screen 15 runs the same game engine as screen 7 and passes the same 26 fail-safe tests.
